name: n-plus-1-lab
description: Lab bài 02/01: N+1 Query và Index khóa ngoại trên PostgreSQL 16

scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U app -d shop -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -v orders=${ORDERS:-500000} -v customers=${CUSTOMERS:-100000} < db/seed-orders.sql
scripts.db:index: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U app -d shop -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < db/add-foreign-key-indexes.sql
scripts.db:unindex: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U app -d shop -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < db/drop-foreign-key-indexes.sql
